subsystem.name: CRTRuntimeSupport
subsystem.responsibility: MSVC C runtime support objects reconstructed from one packet: CRT FILE stream buffering and stream-lock dispatch, an indexed lazy-initialized critical-section table, locale-aware character/string folding plus LCMapString code-page conversion, the printf-family format engine, the MSVC runtime error display handler, inlined locale/stream object construction and destruction, a locale encoding-state query, and atexit-style cleanup-registration wrappers.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 24 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. Two packet-DERIVED owners anchor classes: 0x005932F3 owns CRTRuntimeErrorHandler and 0x005989D7 owns LocaleStreamObject. All other packet owners are UNKNOWN, so functions are grouped into conservative GUESS classes by shared globals and call topology: CRTStreamBuffer (7 stream/FILE buffer functions sharing the off_5E6748 stream array, dword_8D4920 descriptor table, unk_5E6768/unk_5E6788 sentinels and this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x18 buffer layout), CriticalSectionManager (0x0058DFEA/0x0058E04B over the dword_5E6C80 lazy lock table), CRTLocaleString (0x0058B465/0x00596C80/0x00591FA1 sharing the locale flag, the dword_8D5A5C interlocked counter, the dword_8D5A58 thread gate and critical-section 19), LocaleStreamObject (0x005989D7 plus three istream/ostream/streambuf SEH constructors/destructor), LocaleEncodingState (0x005991C3), and CleanupRegistrationList (five one-line wrappers funneling function addresses into BooleanToIntConversion 0x00587B3E). 0x0058FCA0 is a zero-body JUMPOUT thunk left ownerless. CRTStreamBuffer and CRTLocaleString both reach CriticalSectionManager's indexed table, making that class the shared lock primitive. Several stream offsets (+32 embedded CS, 32-byte slot stride, +28 index base, text descriptor flags) are DERIVED from decompiled arithmetic and are flagged in unresolved rather than asserted.

function_roles.role: Locale-aware single-character lowercase conversion: locale flag dword_8D3F38 selects the thread-safe locale path (interlocked refcount dword_8D5A5C, optional critical-section 19, sub_58B4D4 fold) over the ASCII fast path (+32 on 'A'..'Z'); shared character normalizer for sub_5645A0/sub_566810/sub_58BCCF

Stream lock acquire dispatch: streams inside the CRT array [off_5E6748, unk_5E69A8] lock lazy-init CS index ((a1-base)>>5)+28 via CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter; external streams lock their embedded +32 CRITICAL_SECTION via EnterCriticalSection; common lock entry for the CRT stream/file wrappers

Stream lock release dispatch mirroring 0x0058C1B1: CRT-array streams leave lazy-init CS ((a1-base)>>5)+28 via CritSectLeave; external streams call LeaveCriticalSection on the embedded +32 CRITICAL_SECTION

CRT _filbuf-style buffer refill on read underflow: stream-flag validation, MemoryAllocatorInit buffer allocation, sub_58C9B4 read up to this+0x18 bytes, EOF/error flag write, text-mode descriptor copy from unk_5E7898/dword_8D4920, 512->4096 auto-grow; returns the first buffered byte and advances the read pointer

CRT fputc/_flsbuf character output: read-to-write mode switch, buffer allocation when none assigned, flush when full via sub_58E22B, direct one-byte write for unbuffered streams; returns a1 on success or -1 with error bit 0x20 set

printf-family format engine: byte_5B8D88 state-machine dispatch over d/i/u/o/x/X/c/s/S/C/p/n/e/E/f/F/g/G/Z conversions, va-list reads via IntPeekFromPointer, width/precision/length modifiers, float helpers off_5E6730/5E6734/5E673C, padding via LoopWithSentinelTermination and CharByCharStringProcessingWithTerminatorCheck; returns the total character count

Lazy-init indexed critical-section entry: allocate a 24-byte RTL_CRITICAL_SECTION via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc, double-checked install under guard slot 17 (recursive self-call), InitializeCriticalSection, lost-race free via sub_58AA6F, fatal CRTAmsgExit(0x11) on allocation failure; every path ends by entering the table entry
Indexed critical-section release: selects the lock at &dword_5E6C80 + a1 and calls LeaveCriticalSection on it; release half of the enter/init helpers in the same address range

Buffered I/O context init: handle validation via sub_596007, bank index 0/1 by sentinel identity unk_5E6768/unk_5E6788, open-count dword_8D3EC8 increment, 4096-byte heap buffer via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc cached in dword_8D3F50 (or 2-byte inline fallback at this+20), buffer pointers/capacity/count setup, ORs 0x1102 into the flags

Conditional buffer flush and field reset: when guard a1 is nonzero and the byte flag at a2+13 has bit 0x10 set, call BufferFlushWrite(a2), clear the 0x10 bit, and zero the dwords at a2+24/+0/+8; returns the BufferFlushWrite result on that path
Zero-body JUMPOUT thunk: unconditionally transfers control to 0x58FD11 and never continues in this frame; reached from 17 call sites, no fields/globals/callees evidenced

Locale-sensitive string mapping (LCMapString) with automatic code-page conversion: lazy platform-mode detection via dword_8D3FBC (wide vs ANSI), MultiByteToWideChar up-conversion, LCMapStringW, sortkey 0x400 direct-to-destination path or WideCharToMultiByte conversion back; returns mapped length or 0 on failure

MSVC runtime error display handler: scans the (code, description) table dword_5E78C0..off_5E7950, writes the description to the stderr handle via WriteFile when a console is attached, else builds the 'Runtime Error!' message box with GetModuleFileNameA path shortening past 0x3C characters

Case-insensitive bounded string comparison: locale path folds each character pair through sub_58B4D4 under critical-section 19 with interlocked-counter/thread-gate bookkeeping; ASCII fast path manually lowercases 'A'..'Z' by +32; returns -1/0/1 against the remaining-length countdown

Straight-line cleanup-registration wrapper: passes the integer value of WrapperThunk (global 0x00598727) to BooleanToIntConversion for append on the global callback list; returns 0 on success / -1 on failure

Straight-line cleanup-registration wrapper: passes the integer value of ForwardingWrapper (global 0x0059876B) to BooleanToIntConversion for append on the global callback list; returns 0 on success / -1 on failure

Inlined MSVC locale/stream object construction: SEH handler registration, conditional streambuf + std::ios vtable install gated by the flag at this+0x14, std::ostream vtable written into the sub-object slot from the installed vtable, conditional ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet(this+0x8, this+0xC); returns the constructed object pointer

istream-derived __userpurge constructor with SEH handler: gated by a1[4] (offset 0x10) installs the primary vtable unk_5B9BC0 and the std::ios vftable, always installs the std::istream vftable at the vtable-relative slot and calls ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet with arguments from offsets 0x8/0xC; returns the constructed object

istream-derived SEH constructor gated by the flag at this+0xC: installs the primary vtable unk_5B9BC0 and the std::ios vftable, writes the std::istream vftable to the vtable-relative sub-object slot, and finalizes via sub_59A8FA; returns the object pointer

Destructor for an object wrapping a file handle and a refcounted buffer, behind a registered SEH handler: installs the most-derived vtable off_5B9BCC, closes the file at this+0x48 via FileCloseWrapperWithStatus, releases the buffer at this+0x44 (ReferenceCountDecrementWithConditionalFree then FreeWrapper_7bcf), runs null-checked virtual cleanup on this+0x4C and this+0x34, and rebases to the std::streambuf vftable

Locale encoding-state query: reads the object pointer at this+0x50, tests encoding match via sub_587F64, reads two stream dwords via StringStreamReadWithMaskCheck, assembles a 24-byte record (zero, two stream dwords, this+0x40) and copies it into the caller buffer; sub_59942B(-1) default state on the fallback path

Straight-line cleanup-registration wrapper: passes the address of the no-op EmptyStub_aa60 (0x0047AA60) to BooleanToIntConversion for append on the global callback list; returns 0 on success / -1 on failure

Straight-line cleanup-registration wrapper: passes the address of the physics cleanup routine PhysicsBlockWrapper (0x0059980E, runs CDestructorWithVTableChain) to BooleanToIntConversion for append on the global callback list; returns 0 on success / -1 on failure

Straight-line cleanup-registration wrapper: passes the address of the stdcall trampoline TrampolineToFUN005998E5 (0x005998DB, four-argument forwarder to VTableSetSubCall) to BooleanToIntConversion for append on the global callback list; returns 0 on success / -1 on failure

classes.name: CRTStreamBuffer
classes.responsibility: CRT FILE/stream buffer object operations reconstructed from seven packet functions: stream lock acquire/release dispatch (0x0058C1B1, 0x0058C203), read-underflow refill (0x0058C255), character output (0x0058CF35), the printf-family format engine (0x0058D04D), buffered I/O context init (0x0058E41B) and conditional flush/reset (0x0058E4A8). All treat `this` as a CRT stream struct with read pointer at +0x0, byte count +0x4, buffer base +0x8, flags +0xC, OS file handle +0x10 and buffer size +0x18, referencing the CRT global stream array off_5E6748..unk_5E69A8 and the dword_8D4920 descriptor table.

classes.name: CriticalSectionManager
classes.responsibility: Indexed lazy-initialized critical-section primitive over the global lock-pointer table dword_5E6C80: enter (0x0058DFEA) lazily allocates and initializes a 24-byte RTL_CRITICAL_SECTION under a double-checked lock guarded by recursive slot-17 entry and release via CritSectLeave (0x0058E04B). The table is the shared serialization primitive for the CRT stream locks and the locale paths.

classes.name: CRTLocaleString
classes.responsibility: Locale-aware character/string helpers sharing the global locale flag, the dword_8D5A5C interlocked reference counter, the dword_8D5A58 thread gate and critical-section 19: single-character lowercase conversion (0x0058B465), case-insensitive bounded comparison (0x00596C80), and LCMapString mapping with code-page conversion (0x00591FA1). All fold characters through sub_58B4D4 on the locale path with an ASCII 'A'..'Z'+32 fast path.

classes.name: CRTRuntimeErrorHandler
classes.responsibility: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime error display handler (0x005932F3, packet-DERIVED owner CRTErrorHandler): scans the (error code, description) table rooted at dword_5E78C0 with sentinel off_5E7950 and parallel description table off_5E78C4, then either writes to the stderr handle or shows the titled 'Runtime Error!' message box.

classes.name: LocaleStreamObject
classes.responsibility: MSVC locale/stream object construction and destruction: the packet-DERIVED constructor 0x005989D7 plus three GUESS siblings sharing the std::ios/std::istream/std::ostream/std::streambuf vtable globals (0x005B9BB4, 0x005B9BA4, 0x005B9BAC, 0x005B9BB8, 0x005B9BC0, 0x005B9BCC, 0x005B9C04) and the ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet / sub_59A8FA finalizers: istream constructor 0x00598AF5, SEH constructor 0x00598B5D and the file-handle/buffer destructor 0x00598E39.

classes.name: LocaleEncodingState
classes.responsibility: Locale/encoding state query (0x005991C3): reads the encoding-state object pointer at this+0x50, validates the encoding parameters through sub_587F64, reads two dwords through StringStreamReadWithMaskCheck, and copies a 24-byte encoding record (zero header + two stream dwords + the value at this+0x40) into the caller buffer, falling back to a default state from sub_59942B(-1).

classes.name: CleanupRegistrationList
classes.responsibility: Straight-line atexit-style cleanup-registration wrappers: each reads a code address (global callback target) and hands it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), which under a critical section appends the pointer to a global growable callback list and returns 0 on success / -1 on failure. Wrappers: 0x0059871B, 0x0059875F, 0x0059977E, 0x00599802, 0x005998CF.

state_machines.name: PrintfFormatStateMachine
states: literal_chars: ordinary characters tested against off_5E69C8 and emitted via StreamByteOutputWithBufferManagement
conversion_flags: parse ' ', '#', '+', '-', '0' into the flag byte v60
width_precision: literal digits or '*' from the va-list, negative precision clamped to -1
length_modifier: 'h', 'l', 'w', 'I64' set size flags on v60
integer_conversions_diouxxp: sign handling plus repeated sub_594FF0 divide / sub_596100 modulo digit generation
float_conversions_eEfFgG: 8-byte double read, off_5E6730/5E6734/5E673C formatting, Strlen measurement
string_conversions_sSZ: string pointer read, Strlen or wide char-pair scan, off_5E6BE0/5E6BE4 null placeholders
n_conversion: store the running character count through an argument pointer
field_output_padding: pad-count computation and leading/trailing fill via LoopWithSentinelTermination and CharByCharStringProcessingWithTerminatorCheck
transitions: each format character is classified by a 4-bit masked lookup table (aIsprocessorfea) and used to index byte_5B8D88 for the state-machine transition nibble
a negative character count v56 aborts parsing (buffer-overrun protection) and returns v56
empty format string (first char NUL) skips parsing and returns 0
wide-string output path converts each wide char with sub_596030 and writes via CharByCharStringProcessingWithTerminatorCheck

interfaces.name: IStreamLock
interfaces.purpose: Acquire/release the lock guarding a CRT stream object: CRT-array streams (inside off_5E6748..unk_5E69A8) use the lazy-init indexed critical-section path ((a1-base)>>5)+28; external streams lock their embedded CRITICAL_SECTION at +32. Implemented by the lock/unlock dispatch pair 0x0058C1B1 / 0x0058C203.

interfaces.name: ILocaleStringFold
interfaces.purpose: Locale-aware case folding shared by char-to-lower (0x0058B465) and case-insensitive compare (0x00596C80): both fold each character through sub_58B4D4 under critical-section 19 with interlocked-reference/thread-gate bookkeeping, with an ASCII 'A'..'Z'+32 fast path on the non-locale flag value.

interfaces.name: ICleanupRegistration
interfaces.purpose: Registration of a cleanup routine on the global growable callback list: each wrapper passes a code address to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), which appends it under a critical section and returns 0 on success / -1 on failure. Implemented by the five one-line wrappers 0x0059871B, 0x0059875F, 0x0059977E, 0x00599802, 0x005998CF.

compatibility_contracts.name: CRTStreamArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The stream lock/unlock dispatchers (0x0058C1B1, 0x0058C203) classify a stream pointer against the CRT global stream array [off_5E6748, unk_5E69A8]: in-array streams use the lazy-init indexed critical section ((a1-base)>>5)+28; out-of-array streams lock an embedded CRITICAL_SECTION at +32. A replacement executable must preserve the array bounds, the 32-byte slot stride, the +28 index base and the +32 embedded lock offset.

compatibility_contracts.name: CRTStreamDescriptorTable
compatibility_contracts.description: The stream buffer functions (0x0058C255, 0x0058CF35) resolve text-mode descriptors as dword_8D4920[handle>>5] + 36*(handle&0x1F) with the default descriptor unk_5E7898 for handle -1, and drive the flags at this+0xC (0x83 write-capable, 0x40 EOF, bit 0 read-mode, 0x10 own-buffer, 0x10C buffer established). A replacement must keep the descriptor indexing and flag bit meanings.

compatibility_contracts.name: BufferedIOContextLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: BufferedIOContextInit (0x0058E41B) uses a 4096-byte heap buffer cached in dword_8D3F50 by bank (sentinel identity unk_5E6768=bank 0, unk_5E6788=bank 1) with a 2-byte inline fallback at this+20, writes buffer pointers this+0x0/+0x8, capacity this+0x18, remaining count this+0x4, ORs 0x1102 into this+0xC, and increments the open counter dword_8D3EC8. A replacement must preserve the cache, fallback and flag constants.

compatibility_contracts.name: LocaleCharFoldContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Locale-aware case folding (0x0058B465, 0x00596C80) must preserve the ASCII fast path ('A'..'Z' +32, unchanged otherwise) and the locale path that folds each character through sub_58B4D4 under critical-section 19, serialized by the interlocked counter dword_8D5A5C and the thread gate dword_8D5A58; the compare returns -1/0/1 bounded by the maximum length.

compatibility_contracts.name: RuntimeErrorTableLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: ShowRuntimeErrorWithCodeLookup (0x005932F3) scans the (error code, description) pair table rooted at dword_5E78C0 in 2-dword steps to the sentinel off_5E7950, fetching the description from the parallel table off_5E78C4; console path writes via GetStdHandle/WriteFile, message-box path uses GetModuleFileNameA with a 260-char buffer and path shortening beyond 0x3C characters, and code 252 suppresses display. A replacement must keep the table pair and sentinel.

compatibility_contracts.name: LazyCriticalSectionTable
compatibility_contracts.description: CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter (0x0058DFEA) treats dword_5E6C80 as an array of lock pointers indexed by slot a1; slots are lazily allocated (24 bytes) and initialized under a double-checked guard (recursive slot 17) and every enter is paired with a CritSectLeave (0x0058E04B) on the same slot. A replacement must reproduce the slot indexing and the enter/leave pairing.

unresolved: The exact stream type behind `this` in 0x0058C255/0x0058CF35/0x0058E41B (CRT FILE* vs an internal stream struct) is not established by the packet; the buffer layout (+0/+4/+8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x18) is DERIVED from decompiled field usage.
The +28 index base and the 32-byte slot stride for CRT-array streams in 0x0058C1B1/0x0058C203 are DERIVED from the shift/offset arithmetic, not independently proven.
Critical-section identifier 19 is a literal not mapped to a named resource in the packet.
Semantics of the interlocked counter dword_8D5A5C and the thread gate dword_8D5A58 (thread/critical-section bookkeeping) are inferred and unverified.
The exact locale-aware mapping performed by sub_58B4D4 is external to this packet.
Identity and semantics of sub_58AA6F (lost-race free/cleanup) are not established by this packet.
The dword_8D3F50 buffer-cache lifecycle (allocation/reuse/free) outside 0x0058E41B is not visible in this packet.
0x0058FCA0 is a zero-body JUMPOUT thunk whose target 0x58FD11 has no packet entry; whether it is a tail call, jump-table dispatch or plain JMP cannot be determined, and its owner is unknown.
The character-classification table aIsprocessorfea used by 0x0058D04D has no packet evidence entry and its backing address is unverified.
jpt_58D0BB (global 0x0058D76E) is the compiler-generated switch jump table for the 0x0058D04D state dispatch; it has no direct source reference.
sub_594FF0 and sub_596100 are called as 64-bit divide/modulo helpers by 0x0058D04D, but their exact semantics are only inferred from usage.

The SEH exception type descriptors 0x0059D23E, 0x0059D286, 0x0059D2AA, 0x0059D2EF participate in the LocaleStreamObject frames but are not referenced by name in the visible constructor/destructor bodies.

The a1-relative stack slots (a1-20/-16/-4/-5/-1) written by the LocaleStreamObject constructors belong to inlined caller frames; the exact object layout they describe is not recoverable from these functions alone.
The this+0x44 refcounted buffer, the this+0x48 file-open flag and the this+0x4C/this+0x34 sub-object virtual-cleanup slots in 0x00598E39 are unproven beyond ordering evidence.
In 0x005991C3 this+0x50 doubles as both the masked-read stream and the encoding-state object pointer; the exact class contract is not recoverable from this packet alone.
Whether the CleanupRegistrationList callbacks fire through atexit-style teardown, a destructor chain, or manual dispatch is not established by this packet.
BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) returns 0 on successful append and -1 on failure per the wrapper prose; this contract is DERIVED and unverified.

EnterCriticalSection/LeaveCriticalSection/InitializeCriticalSection and the other Win32 entry points are indirect global function pointers (0x0059E16C/0x0059E170/0x0059E174); their import bindings are assumed, not proven.
